ask: Hi! I have wanted one of these for ages and yours looks perfect. Is it still available? What is the lowest you would take?
text:
Hi! Yes, it's still available.

Since you mentioned it looks perfect, I just want to be upfront about a couple of things: there's a small tear on the saddle, and the gears can be a bit clunky when it's cold. Other than that it's been well looked after, with a service in March and new tyres fitted in June.

With those bits in mind, I'm definitely flexible on the £450. What sort of price did you have in mind? If size M is the right fit for you, you're also very welcome to come take a look and try it out before deciding.

ask: I have fallen for this piece, and I can already see it on my wall. How big is it? Is the price firm?
text:
Dear Leo,

Thank you so much for your message. I assist Ines in the studio, and it is wonderful to hear how much Tidewrack III speaks to you.

The piece (2025, oil and beeswax on linen) measures 120 x 90 cm and was exhibited at Fold Gallery in March. For completeness, I should mention that there is a faint scuff on the lower left edge of the frame, and I would be very happy to send over a close-up photo if you would like to take a look.

The listed price is £4,000, though it isn't strictly firm. Ines has some flexibility, so if you have an offer in mind, please feel free to share it. Do also let me know if any additional photos or details on framing and delivery would be helpful.

Best wishes,
Ines's Studio
